user_signal.goal_or_constraint: The GitHub migration must produce real Agent products that self-route, execute, evaluate, recover and monitor architecture drift without requiring the user to repeatedly enumerate missing review dimensions.
user_signal.proposed_mechanism: Reconsider whether the control plane should use Agent, Skill, Harness, monitoring or another upper-layer system; compare against compact proven Skill patterns rather than defaulting to the existing path.
user_signal.counterexample: Financial had a real runtime and CI but a roughly 20KB Skill still duplicated substantial product rules; Universal itself had a thin Skill while mandatory ENTRYPOINT bootstrap had grown to roughly 17KB. A stale maintenance chat also discovered architecture drift but had no non-authoritative delivery path to the active writer, so the user had to raise the issue again.

failure_classes: implicit Agent-productization acceptance: GitHub cutover validated engineering authority/versioning/CI but did not mechanically define Skill-versus-Runtime-versus-Workflow-versus-Harness responsibilities
thin-Skill/fat-bootstrap split: Universal Skill was thin while mandatory ENTRYPOINT/STARTUP surfaces still carried large duplicated contract detail
owner architecture drift invisibility: an owner could retain a large Skill or change runtime/harness shape without a shared architecture contract or cross-owner validator

state-plane/signal-plane conflation: a stale chat correctly stopped authoritative writes but had no first-class non-authoritative way to deliver a newly discovered systemic signal to the current writer
remote freshness gap: local Universal CI could validate cached owner observations but could not itself discover a newer private owner HEAD
user-trigger dependence: the control plane did not proactively treat Agent productization/Skill bloat/monitoring completeness as a standing architecture invariant

sources.observation: Agent products can stay small at the orchestration surface while delegating execution to agents/tools/guardrails and preserving tracing rather than encoding the whole workflow as one giant prompt.
sources.rationale: Supports explicit Runtime/Workflow/Harness separation and rejecting Skill prose as execution evidence.

sources.observation: Execution traces expose agent runs, generations, tool activity and workflow structure as an observation surface distinct from the instruction text.
sources.rationale: Supports treating Harness/observation as a separate product layer and preserving higher assurance for real traces rather than self-description.

sources.rationale: Directly supports the thin Skill/thin bootstrap architecture and event-driven authority loading.

sources.rationale: Supports a narrow deterministic Universal architecture harness instead of another permanent supervisory LLM Agent.

sources.ref: DSPy GEPA/MIPROv2 previously reviewed in this maintenance task
sources.observation: Automated instruction/program optimization is useful when a trustworthy evaluator and train/validation split exist, but it is not an architecture-truth oracle.
sources.rationale: Do not install an optimizer as the main control-plane judge before architecture-quality metrics have trustworthy held-out validation.

alternatives.rationale: More prose cannot independently detect Skill/runtime/harness responsibility leakage or remote owner freshness.
Framework branding is not the invariant; deterministic, hybrid and repository-native runtimes can be valid and forcing tool APIs would create fake capability declarations.
Without a distinct executor/trace/evaluator boundary it would reproduce self-attestation while increasing prompt and coordination cost.

Separates responsibilities mechanically, keeps shared checks centralized, reduces hot-path context, preserves single-writer authority and gives unattended/stale observers a non-authoritative way to surface drift.

instruction_surface.reason: The demonstrated defect included a fat mandatory repository bootstrap, so ENTRYPOINT.md and STARTUP_HOOK.md were reduced to routing/kernel semantics with byte-budget regressions. No claim is made that repository edits changed the user's account-level Custom Instructions; real product propagation remains separately evidenced.

second_order_findings: Putting current/validated HEAD inside the static owner manifest would make a manifest write invalidate its own freshness receipt; freshness moved to a rebuildable external observation cache.

Requiring a formal tool surface for every Agent would make repository-native Novel execution fabricate a capability; tool_surface_refs is optional while executable runtime entrypoints remain mandatory.
Copying the architecture checker into every owner would recreate cross-repository semantic drift; shared architecture validation stays central while owner CI keeps domain suites.
A hard Skill-size failure would confuse context architecture drift with runtime nonexistence; oversized Skills produce PASS_WITH_DRIFT while missing runtime/workflow/harness fails.

Slimming ENTRYPOINT initially broke historical tests that encoded both obsolete version duplication and still-valid kernel semantics; obsolete duplication tests were replaced, while valid existing-chat/progress/blocker semantics were restored without relaxing the byte budget.
The daily remote watch is an observation/notification surface, not an authoritative writer. It can emit/update control signals but cannot mutate owner business state or acquire leases.
A monitor task existing does not itself prove it will catch every future unknown architecture failure class; first real drift detection remains future operational evidence.

open_gates: Financial, Novel and Video Skills remain above the 8192-byte thin-router target and are tracked as architecture drift until owner-specific safe slimming is completed and revalidated.
The Agent Architecture Watch has not yet produced a first real drift alert trajectory; it is enabled monitoring infrastructure, not evidence of future recall quality.
Universal operator-dependence still requires independent held-out/live maintenance trajectory grading and a distinct evidence verifier.
A truly fresh product chat with a newly admitted real BUSINESS owner remains unproven.
Owner real actions still require methodology receipt 1.3 exact-action independent verification where applicable.
Financial live prose-quality/Personalized Writing DNA outcome evidence and Video strict isolated review remain open.
Arbitrary ChatGPT-to-GitHub mutation still lacks universal pre-write WRITE_PATH_ENFORCED semantics.
closure.unknown_or_open_world_boundary: The architecture contract, harness, signal transport and remote watch reduce known operator dependence and make several drift classes proactively observable. They do not prove global flawlessness or that every future Agent/model/tool/product failure class has already been anticipated.
